agentmemory.why: Watching a thread fill, compact and write facts turn by turn shows memory as data flow; the stepper lets you try it.

llmobs.why: Clicking through a real span tree to find the slow and costly step builds the core skill; the diagram shows the feedback loop.

labeling.why: Computing agreement on real disagreements makes kappa click, and labeling your own small batch is the only way to learn guidelines.

voice.why: Moving stage sliders against an 800 ms target makes the latency budget tangible; the animation shows audio flowing turn by turn.
